Question 2
?
Consider the following relation over the sets A={−2,−1,1,2} and B={5,7,9}.

R={(−2,5),(1,5),(1,7),(2,7)} What are the domain and range of this relation?

The domain is
 
{−2,−1,1,2}
{−2,1,2}
{1,2}
{5,7}

The range is
 
{5,7,9}
{5,7}
{−2,1,2}
{−2,−1,1,2}
Submit
